baseline_rationale: The old jade-1.6-to-1.7 run declared baseline_path=JADE-4.6.0 (pristine source tree). That tree's build.xml has source="1.5" target="1.5" and carries none of the jade-1.5-to-1.6 fixes (no STRICTER_CAST_CHECKING markers, no source/target upgrade). Chaining a version-migration pipeline from the pristine tree instead of the prior step's output workspace silently discards every change the previous jump made. migration-runs/jade-1.5-to-1.6/workspace is the verified correct baseline for this run: its build.xml already reads source="1.6" target="1.6" (confirmed by diff against JADE-4.6.0/src/jade/build.xml) and rule-status.json shows STRICTER_CAST_CHECKING as DONE for that run. It is the actual 1.6-level codebase this v2 run must start from.
